project.title: Concrete native HTTP JSON v1 auth-mail gateway
project.goal: Deliver existing auth messages with source-compatible wire/HMAC, bounded retries/time and confidential validated TLS
project.scope: R41 internal concrete provider adapter; no public dispatch/deployment/distribution/cutover

boundary.responsibility: Validated configured HTTPS handoff with source wire, explicit TLS/DNS policy, monotonic retry budget and opaque uncertainty
boundary.rationale: Internal auth flows need a real Rust transport with truthful external effects and no secret forwarding
excludes: Action authorization/database state, public endpoints/worker admission, durable delivery/outbox, private/system trust expansion and full platform release

action.auth_mail.description: Send source-compatible confidential auth mail through configured validated HTTPS gateway

errors.refused: InvalidConfig during setup; DeliveryUnconfirmed for input/transport/status/budget failure without delivery-or-rollback guarantee

preconditions: Trusted use case authorizes the message and holds no database writer during send
Configured sender constructed outside async executor/request critical path; public bounded worker admission and release/platform gates remain binding
postconditions: At most3 explicit same-body/key attempts within monotonic8-second send budget under ordinary scheduling
Only configured HTTPS endpoint receives content; validated TLS/no redirects/proxies and opaque failure preserve confidential boundary
external_effects: Up to3 TLS HTTP POSTs to configured gateway using source contract/HMAC
Prepared configured async DNS as needed; no database, responsebody parsing or background/new-token delivery

authorization.rationale: External failure can follow acceptance. Bound same-message attempts, suppress raw secrets, validate explicit TLS/DNS policy and preserve postcommit ownership; construction/destruction are not delivery-budget proof.
